utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. Madam Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is the case IT-04-75-T, the Prosecutor versus Goran Hadzic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Yes, indeed. I was checking whether I had something wrong with mine, but was your microphone on, Madam Registrar?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: It still is. Yes, it was.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Well, we didn't hear anything. I'm on 4. The transcript is okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Yeah, okay. But the interpreters had a problem.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours, again. This is the case IT-04-75-T, the Prosecutor versus Goran Hadzic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Could we have the appearances, please, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, Your Honours. For the Prosecution, Douglas Stringer, Lisa Biersay, Thomas Laugel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Zivanovic, for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For the Defence of Goran Hadzic, Zoran Zivanovic and Christopher Gosnell. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Stringer, I take it you have something.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. If we could move into private session, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 27th day of August, 2013, at 9.00 a.m. 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 9.06 a.m.,
